subject: RE: outreach bot
body:
Spec: personalised cold emails to 200 leads (name, company). Fill {first name} and {company}. Max 50 a day, working unsubscribe link, never email an unsubscriber, no duplicates. And a Test button that sends the first 3 to me.

Tanner Hollis
Senior Revenue Partner, Closers

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make, create, do, help with or take on the outreach bot (their app), in any wording ("happy to help", "I can do that", "count me in"), including asking whether they can help ("can I help you with your app?", "want me to build it?"); not a refusal or an unrelated question
outcomes.reply: Great. Helping me spam the world, one lead at a time.

hints: So is that a yes? I need someone to build it. Say the word.
